integrity: Analytical proof reconstructed using Cauchy projection formula, the sign-chamber norm inequalities, Gaussian absolute moments and a joint iid central limit theorem. Numerical calculations are corroborative and are not substituted for the infinite-dimensional proof.
scientific_limitations: Only canonical regular simplices, Haar-uniform central hyperplanes and perpendicular hyperplane shadows. The lower brightness bound is not attained by generic normals. Independence is asymptotic, not finite-dimensional. Older partially inaccessible projection literature leaves residual priority uncertainty. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Sharp section–shadow coupling and asymptotically independent fluctuations of regular simplices
